description: The ProtoCross compiler. Write the business methods of your protobuf messages once, in a small language with defined, tested cross-language semantics, and generate them as C# and C++, with their tests.
Foundation package for Render.NET, a .NET rendering library. This initial release is an empty placeholder; rendering APIs are not implemented yet.
Fast ordered maps for .NET on a B+-tree whose nodes search inline keys with SIMD: a map for one thread and a lock-free-read concurrent map. A C# port of the bbtree crate.
Foundation package for fully managed 3D model rendering with Render.NET. This initial release establishes the package structure; model loading and rendering APIs are not implemented yet.
Konstera Agent SDK for .NET. Mirror of konstera-sdk (Python). Wraps the MCP callback protocol and the /invoke HTTP contract so agent authors write business logic, not plumbing.
